# Truly Free: Founding Archive (working title)

**Status:** working founding archive, not a published standard, adopted license, launched product, or verified organization.  
**Captured:** October 17, 2026; launch-handoff materials added afterward.  
**Working identities:** Jolly Roger (movement / emblem), The Pirate Charter (manifesto), Truly Free (philosophy), Open Stewardship Standard (possible neutral specification), Quartermaster (possible reference application). Names are **not cleared** for use.

> **Free. Libre. Truly Free.**  
> **You can't pirate what belongs to everyone.**  
> **Could your software survive without you?**

## Essential premise

As agents make software cheaper to build, a software provider's durable value shifts from controlling the code toward **stewardship**: maintaining, securing, deploying, hosting, improving and supporting it. A genuinely independent application lets another person reproduce the product, understand its development, see its operating economics, migrate user-controlled data and continue service without the original creator.

**Founding line (retain verbatim):**

> If we can explain how to build it, we should explain how to run it. If we can explain how to run it, we should explain what it costs. And if someone can make it better or cheaper, they should be free to try.

**Six proposed commitments:**

1. Free creation and reproduction, including commercial copying and resale.
2. Open, reproducible, agent-native development and deployment.
3. User-controlled, portable data and identity with AT Protocol at the core.
4. Replaceable, competitively supplied stewardship.
5. Quantifiable, transparent, privacy-safe operating economics.
6. Open improvement, governance, debate and infrastructure optimization.

The **freedom to continue** unifies them: the project must remain useful when the creator, host, maintainer, AI vendor or financial sponsor disappears.

## Next step: Claude-led public launch

**Start with [`CLAUDE-LAUNCH-HANDOFF.md`](CLAUDE-LAUNCH-HANDOFF.md)**. This is an actionable work order for Claude to create a human-owned free GitHub organization, push this repository, build an Eleventy website, verify and register a domain with explicit purchase approval, open debate and challenge mechanisms, and prepare a zero-paid-media campaign. It preserves genuine AI attribution and a human-reviewed path for publishing the complete founding conversation.

Working naming: **Jolly Roger Charter** (movement), **JRCv1** (draft conformance *charter*, not yet a legal software license), `jollyrogercharter` (preferred GitHub org), `jollyrogercharter.org` (preferred domain; **not confirmed registrable**), **Quartermaster** (billing reference app). No external accounts or domains are asserted as registered.

Additional implementation sources: [`website/SITE-SPEC.md`](website/SITE-SPEC.md), [`transparency/AI-PROVENANCE-POLICY.md`](transparency/AI-PROVENANCE-POLICY.md), [`transparency/CONVERSATION-PUBLICATION.md`](transparency/CONVERSATION-PUBLICATION.md), [`launch/ORGANIC-MARKETING-PLAN.md`](launch/ORGANIC-MARKETING-PLAN.md), [`launch/OPERATIONS-LEDGER.md`](launch/OPERATIONS-LEDGER.md), [`launch/LAUNCH-STATUS.md`](launch/LAUNCH-STATUS.md), [`launch/NEXT-ACTIONS.md`](launch/NEXT-ACTIONS.md).

The `FOUNDING-ARCHIVE.md` and prior Word file are **historical editorial snapshots**, not verbatim transcripts or a complete live status report. The original chat transcript needs exact source material and explicit privacy review before public publication.

## Documents

- [standard/HUMAN-ATTENTION.md](standard/HUMAN-ATTENTION.md) — new proposal: openly governed valuation of paid, donated and user attention costs, separately from provider bills.


- [MANIFESTO.md](MANIFESTO.md) — long-form philosophical draft.
- [CHARTER.md](CHARTER.md) — charter principles and boundaries.
- [standard/CONFORMANCE.md](standard/CONFORMANCE.md) — evidence-based adoption and conformity.
- [standard/DATA-SOVEREIGNTY.md](standard/DATA-SOVEREIGNTY.md) — AT Protocol, portability, permissions, privacy.
- [standard/AGENTIC-REPRODUCIBILITY.md](standard/AGENTIC-REPRODUCIBILITY.md) — transparency of agentic work and release process.
- [standard/OPEN-ECONOMICS.md](standard/OPEN-ECONOMICS.md) — live billing, accounting, infrastructure proposals.
- [community/GOVERNANCE-AND-DEBATE.md](community/GOVERNANCE-AND-DEBATE.md) — open criticism, distributed maintenance, succession.
- [community/THE-CHALLENGE.md](community/THE-CHALLENGE.md) — **Could your software survive without you?**
- [strategy/ORGANIC-LAUNCH.md](strategy/ORGANIC-LAUNCH.md) — zero-paid-media distribution and early roadmap.
- [strategy/MESSAGING-AND-HISTORY.md](strategy/MESSAGING-AND-HISTORY.md) — narrative, historical sources, verified quotes.
- [product/QUARTERMASTER.md](product/QUARTERMASTER.md) — proposed first cost-transparency product.
- [research/PRECEDENTS.md](research/PRECEDENTS.md) — earlier movements and originality limits.
- [legal/LICENSE-AND-RISK.md](legal/LICENSE-AND-RISK.md) — public-domain, ownership, privacy and patent constraints.
- [DECISIONS-AND-QUESTIONS.md](DECISIONS-AND-QUESTIONS.md) — agreed preferences vs. open design choices.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) — how agents and humans should continue working on the charter.
- [templates/open-infrastructure.example.yaml](templates/open-infrastructure.example.yaml) — **illustrative** cost and infra record, not a working integration.
- [SOURCES.md](SOURCES.md) — verified links and context.

`FOUNDING-ARCHIVE.md` contains the complete concatenated record for preservation, searchable handoff and offline reading. It is regenerated from the above modular files.

## Intellectual humility

No claim of inventing free software, public-domain dedication, paid support, agentic development, or cost management. The potentially distinctive contribution is the **combination**, made independently verifiable. No exhaustive worldwide novelty search has established firstness.

## Important limits

- This is not legal advice. Do **not** publish a final `LICENSE` claiming CC0 until rights in all included material are reviewed.
- User control of data cannot be created by a copyright waiver. It needs product architecture, consent, service terms and applicable legal safeguards.
- Public AT Protocol repositories can be replicated; private records need separate protections. Spaces was alpha as of October 17, 2026.
- Publicly documenting development does not mean publishing secrets, user information, third-party licensed material or actionable vulnerabilities.
- A cost-based stewardship pledge is voluntary for adopters, not a restriction attached to free code.
- Merely drafting documents here has **not** created a public Git repository, registered an organization or deployed any service.

## Verifiable founding record: planned, not yet issued

A new proposed JRCv1 component is **Proof of Origin and Development History**. We intend to publish the reviewed founding ChatGPT conversation with independently checkable SHA-256 fingerprints, versioned Git history, and portable OpenTimestamps proofs (state labeled `not requested`, `pending`, or `verified`). This is about trustworthy creation records, **not exclusive rights, OpenAI certification, or proof of global firstness**.

- [Provenance specification and accurate claims](provenance/README.md)
- [How to verify a real published proof](provenance/VERIFY.md)
- [Illustrative proof manifest (not actual evidence)](provenance/proof-manifest.example.json)
- [Source-transcript and redaction policy](transparency/CONVERSATION-PUBLICATION.md)

**Current status:** no true conversation-source export or human-approved public transcript has been provided to this package; no independent timestamp has been issued or verified here.

## Website and launch state

The static website in `site/` is generated from these Markdown files: `npm ci && npm test` builds it into `_site/` and checks it. See [`DEPLOYMENT.md`](DEPLOYMENT.md) for hosting anywhere, [`launch/LAUNCH-STATUS.md`](launch/LAUNCH-STATUS.md) for what is and isn't live, [`OPEN-DEPENDENCIES.md`](OPEN-DEPENDENCIES.md) for what still depends on the founder, and [`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md) for history.

DEPLOYMENT.md.text:
# Deployment

**Current state (2026-10-18):** not deployed anywhere. Nothing below has been run against a live host yet; `launch/LAUNCH-STATUS.md` records when that changes.

The site is plain static files. Any host that serves a directory works, and no step needs a secret, an API key or an account other than the host's own.

## Build locally

```bash
git clone https://github.com/jollyrogercharter/charter.git   # URL pending org creation
cd charter
npm ci            # Node 20+; exact versions come from package-lock.json
npm test          # builds _site/ and runs the checks in test/
```

`npm run build` alone produces `_site/`. `npm run serve` gives a local preview on http://localhost:8080.

Two environment variables change output, both optional:

| Variable | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `SITE_URL` | `https://jollyrogercharter.org` | Canonical URLs, feed and sitemap. Set it when deploying to a temporary or alternative address. |
| `REPO_URL` | `https://github.com/jollyrogercharter/charter` | Source, issue and commit links. Set it for a fork or if the org name changes. |

## Option A: Cloudflare Pages (candidate primary host, free plan)

Human steps, done in the Cloudflare dashboard by the account owner:

1. Workers & Pages → Create → Pages → Connect to Git → select the `charter` repository.
2. Build command `npm ci && npm run build`; output directory `_site`; environment variables `NODE_VERSION=22`, `SITE_URL=https://<project>.pages.dev` until the domain exists.
3. Leave Web Analytics off. The charter forbids forced tracking.
4. Production branch `main`; preview deployments on pull requests are fine.

Pages serves `_site/404.html` automatically for unknown paths.

## Option B: GitHub Pages

Settings → Pages → Source: GitHub Actions, then add a workflow that runs `npm ci && npm test` and uploads `_site` with `actions/upload-pages-artifact` + `actions/deploy-pages`. Set `SITE_URL=https://<org>.github.io/charter` **and** be aware the site assumes it is served from the domain root; a project-path deploy needs Eleventy's `pathPrefix` set to `/charter/`. A custom domain avoids that.

## Option C: anything else

```bash
SITE_URL=https://example.net npm run build
rsync -a --delete _site/ user@host:/var/www/charter/   # or upload _site/ via any static host UI
```

Netlify, Vercel static, S3 + CloudFront, a Raspberry Pi with Caddy: all equivalent. Configure the server to return `/404.html` for missing paths.

## Verify a deploy

```bash
curl -sI https://<host>/ | head -1                 # 200
curl -s https://<host>/provenance/launch-manifest.json | shasum -a 256
shasum -a 256 provenance/launch-manifest.json      # must match
```

CI uploads `_site` plus `site-checksums.txt` as an artifact for each run, so a deployed file can be compared against the build that produced it.

## Rollback

Every deploy is a commit on `main`. Roll back by reverting the commit (`git revert <sha>` and push) or, on Cloudflare Pages, by promoting the previous deployment in the dashboard. No database or state exists to restore.

## Dependency hygiene

Eleventy is pinned to 3.1.6. `npm audit` reports build-time DoS advisories in transitive `braces` and `sprintf-js`, fixed by Eleventy 3.1.7 (published 2026-10-15). They only affect parsing of our own committed content. Upgrade once 3.1.7 has a couple of weeks of soak (target: on or after 2026-10-29), then rerun `npm test`.
